# Fixed ClassFieldTheory sources

This directory contains 871 Lean modules from
[n-yamaguchi-0729/ClassFieldTheory](https://github.com/n-yamaguchi-0729/ClassFieldTheory),
fixed at commit `2930b56f4b5c33ddab9ef91a45a4811d6f7a683f`.
It includes 540 ClassFieldTheory, 257 ValuedFieldTheory, and 74 GaloisCohomology
modules. The Lean source files are unmodified.

[SOURCES.json](SOURCES.json) records the selected entry modules, every retained
source path, byte count, and SHA-256 digest. The original [Apache-2.0 license](LICENSE)
is preserved.

The top-level Lake project uses Lean/Mathlib 4.33.1 and `--trust=0`.
Only the ClassFieldTheory library has a bounded `maxHeartbeats=1000000` setting.
The source revision is fixed and is not updated automatically. The upstream
project's toolchain and dependency configuration are not used.
